subject: Analog Electronics
questionText:
In the following amplifier circuit, the op-amp is ideal. 
 
 
What is the value of current I1, I2 and I3 respectively? 
 
(a) 10 mA, 1 A, 100 A 
 
(b) 100 A, 100 A, 1 A 
 
(c) 100 A, 100 A, 10 A 
 
(d) 10 mA, 1 A, 100 A
explanation: Practice Question from Analog Electronics DPP-05 (EC/EE/IN).
